module: Flowgraph node "Get ScatterSky" (category provider, tags environment/tod). Reads the current parameters of the ScatterSky sky via core_environment. Outputs: skyBrightness (global brightness) and, hidden, the gradient files (string): colorizeGradientFile (sky color), sunScaleGradientFile (sun), ambientScaleGradientFile (ambient), fogScaleGradientFile (fog), nightGradientFile (night ambient), nightFogGradientFile (night fog).

work.desc: Every frame, reads the seven values from core_environment and writes them to the outputs.
